_description: Rolling weekly KPI buffer. Appended by /security-report. Powers every sparkline and delta indicator on the dashboard. Keep the buffer bounded (the reference impl keeps the last 26 weeks).

weeks[].grade: letter grade (A | B+ | B | C+ | C)
weeks[].mttr_crit: mean time-to-remediate critical findings in days
weeks[].mttr_high: mean time-to-remediate high findings in days
weeks[].grc_avg_residual: average residual risk score across the register
weeks[].framework_a_test_pct: control test pass rate for framework A
weeks[].framework_b_test_pct: control test pass rate for framework B
weeks[].framework_a_ctrl_pct: control documentation completion rate for framework A
weeks[].framework_b_ctrl_pct: control documentation completion rate for framework B
weeks[].controls_unowned: count of controls without an owner
weeks[].corroborated_gaps: count of compliance gaps with finding evidence
weeks[].controls_contradicted: count of controls where test status conflicts with evidence
weeks[].risks_mapped: count of risks with at least one corroborating finding
weeks[].teams: object — team_key -> { crit, high, med, score }
